answer: A network that pays per identity must price identity itself. Social-graph flow limits: each identity may endorse only 7 newcomers per epoch, and endorsement weight decays with graph distance from established roots, so a farm cannot bootstrap itself. 700 aliases need 700 genuine endorsements from distinct trusted branches. Branches that never touch the trusted core earn nothing at all. The grove test is the live device, the haven test is the locked stake, and the zenith test is the graded history no template can fake. Pay the price once, or pay it a thousand times — the farm chooses.
